name: Coasters Drive-In
description: The most popular and beloved dining destination at Canada's Wonderland — Coasters Drive-In is a vibrant 1950s American drive-in diner serving classic burgers, milkshakes, hot dogs and fries in a fun retro atmosphere. One of the most iconic and frequently visited restaurants at any Canadian theme park.

items.name: Classic Smash Burger
items.description: Double smash patty with American cheese and drive-in sauce

items.name: Vanilla Milkshake
items.description: Thick creamy hand-spun milkshake

items.name: Poutine
items.description: Classic Canadian poutine with cheese curds and gravy

items.name: Hot Dog
items.description: Classic American hot dog in a toasted bun

name: Market Grill
description: A spacious and popular grill restaurant at Canada's Wonderland serving generous portions of grilled chicken, burgers, pasta and Canadian comfort food. One of the largest and most convenient full-service dining options at the park for families.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Platter
items.description: Flame-grilled chicken breast with fries and coleslaw

items.name: BBQ Beef Burger
items.description: Angus beef burger with BBQ sauce, bacon and cheddar

items.name: Penne Alfredo
items.description: Creamy penne pasta with parmesan and garlic bread

items.name: Soft Drink
items.description: Large fountain drink

name: All's Well Hall
description: A large food hall at Canada's Wonderland offering multiple food stations with diverse dining options including pizza, pasta, Asian cuisine and classic North American comfort food — the most comprehensive and flexible dining option at the park.

items.name: Pizza Slice
items.description: Classic cheese and pepperoni pizza by the slice

items.description: Classic Chinese-American general tso chicken with fried rice

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.description: Classic Caesar with romaine, croutons and parmesan

items.name: Funnel Cake

name: Carrousel Kitchen
description: A charming and atmospheric restaurant near the iconic Carrousel at Canada's Wonderland serving classic Canadian comfort food and quick-service meals in a friendly family setting.

items.name: Chicken Strips Combo
items.description: Crispy chicken strips with fries and dipping sauce

name: Funnel Cake Co.
description: The most beloved fairground sweet treat experience at Canada's Wonderland — Funnel Cake Co. serves freshly fried funnel cakes with a wide variety of toppings from classic powdered sugar to Nutella, berries and ice cream. The most popular dessert destination at any Canadian theme park.
